name: NovelAI Image SDK v0.1.4
body:
Publishes the PyPI wheel.

## Fixed

- PyPI rejected the Linux wheel (`linux_x86_64` is not an installable tag). The runner's glibc is newer than any long-term-support baseline, so the Linux wheel now builds inside the official `manylinux_2_28` container and is repaired with `auditwheel`; the tag reflects the symbols the binary actually requires.

crates.io, Maven and the npm packages published at earlier patch versions; this release differs only in the Python wheel.
